_what: The posting calendar screen (src/workspace/calendar-screen.tsx), as DATA. `calendar` is the one calendar view in the shared record views' bar (its id is the Calendar every list is offered, so the screen's own takes its place); `views` are the month, week and day its header offers, each `view` the shared ScheduleCalendar's view ({ grid: month } or { grid: hours, days }); `table` is the plain list of the same posts. `status` names each post status in words and the look's tone that colours its tag and its card (a status with no row draws in its own words, grey). `hour_window` is the minutes of a day the hour lanes show, `start_scroll_minute` where they start scrolled, `snap_minutes` the steps a drop lands on and `post_minutes` how tall a post is in a lane. `words` is every sentence the screen says; {title}, {when}, {count} and {said} are filled in.

words.tray_empty: Every draft has a time. Drag a post here to take its time away.
words.placing: {title} goes out {when}. Let go to set this time.
words.unplacing: Let go to take the time away from {title}.
words.now_a_draft: {title} moved, so it is a draft again. Approve it again to keep it going out at its new time.
words.approved_past: Approved. Its time has passed, so publish it from Posts when you are ready.
words.cannot_move: This post has already gone out, so its time stays.
words.no_posts: No post here yet. Write one or ask your AI to draft one, then drag it to the day and hour it should go out.
words.ask_ai: Ask my AI to draft a post
